MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 318 October 22, 1973
LIMITING THE POWER OF CITIES TO INCREASE TAX ON PETROLEUM PRODUCTS
I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers in me vested by the
Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and pursuant to Proclamation
No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1, dated September 22, 1972, do hereby order
That notwithstanding the provisions of Section 24 of Article 3, Chapter II of the Local Tax Code, the cities
shall not increase the rate of taxes imposed by them on petroleum products and prevailing at the time of the
promulgation of the order of the Oil Industry Commission dated October 20, 1973, increasing the price of
petroleum products which is likewise the date of effectivity of Presidential Decree No. 314, increasing the
specific tax on petroleum products.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of October, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
